sum: Ambadi Investments Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, indicating a substantial stake acquisition in Tube Investments of India Limited.
detail: Ambadi Investments Limited has submitted a disclosure document to NSE in compliance with SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, specifically under Regulation 31(4) and 31(5), which mandate disclosure when a person acquires 25% or more of shares or voting rights, or acquires control. The filing is captured in the NSE corporate governance archive. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition value, and timeline mechanics are contained within the formal disclosure document. This is a regulatory milestone event signalling a material change in control or beneficial ownership at TIINDIA.
